headline: Enhance CodeClip with Modern Features
summary: Integrate real-time collaboration tools and code formatting options to make the CodeSnipper Clipper and Organizer more user-friendly and efficient for developers. Implement a dark mode theme to enhance usability in low-light environments.
actions: Add real-time collaboration features, allowing users to share and edit snippets simultaneously with others.
Integrate automatic code formatting tools to ensure consistency across all stored snippets.
Implement a dark mode theme to improve visibility and reduce eye strain during late-night coding sessions.
